🚨🎖| 𝐁𝐑𝐄𝐀𝐊𝐈𝐍𝐆: Alejandro Balde is open to LEAVING Barcelona in January. He is beginning to feel that a move away may be the best way to get regular game time and rebuild his confidence after the events of the last few weeks. [@martinezferran] #fcblive

🚨🎖| Balde is disappointed with Flick, as he expected the manager to be honest and speak to him directly. Before the transfer window closed, Flick personally informed Casadó and Fort that they were unlikely to get minutes. Balde, however, received no direct communication, with all messages instead coming through the manager’s press conferences. [@martinezferran] #fcblive 🚨

❗| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Training updates —

• Christensen did not train with the group

• Orian Goren trained with the first team

• Ebrima Tunkara was not with the squad. [@jbatalla7] #fcblive

🚨 Anthony Gordon's press-conference:

“My adaptation so far? I’d give yself a 7–7.5/10. I started quite well, considering the huge change it has been for me and my family. But as I’ve said since arriving, I can do more. The best of me is YET to come.” #fcblive #UCL
🚨🎙️| Anthony Gordon: “Everyone has made me feel welcome. It’s great to be part of a team like this, and people like Eric have helped me a lot with my adaptation.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Anthony Gordon: “Competition with Karim Adeyemi? I only measure myself against myself. I don’t look at competition with my teammates; I focus on how I can handle things, what I can bring to the team and how I can become the best version of myself, whether I play 90 minutes or less.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Anthony Gordon, on Aston Villa: “I’ve played against them several times, and they’re in good form at the moment. They’re always focused and wait for their opportunities. It will be a challenge, but I’m looking forward to tomorrow’s game.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Anthony Gordon: “The challenge of playing for Barça is different from anywhere else. Before, I was competing to qualify for the Champions League; now, I’m competing to win every trophy.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Anthony Gordon: “Scoring goals and providing assists can change the course of a match. That’s what I want to improve on. I think there are moments when I should be more individualistic, but my main aim is to help the team.” #fcblive
